Name: Mandatory Meals
Author: Darzington
Description:
Each day, players receive a quest to eat a real meal: something cooked, not harvested or foraged. Eating a meal completes the quest, and if players fail to eat a meal then the next day they will only recover half as much stamina from sleeping. 

Some cooked foods don't count as meals, namely [i]Oil of Garlic[/i], [i]Life Elixir[/i], and [i]Triple Shot Espresso[/i].

This mod will make the start of the game considerably more difficult: players will need to spend more of their money and time on getting meals from the saloon, will likely fail to eat a meal often, and will basically be living on trashcan baguettes.

Manifest.Name: RealLifeMod
Manifest.Description: A real life mod which pushes players to eat a full meal each day, and go to sleep at a reasonable hour.
Manifest.Author: darzington
